mapper.insert: MERGE INTO cargo_snapshot AS target USING ( VALUES ( #{bookingId}, #{trackingNumber}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{cargoType}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{bookingStatus} ) ) AS source ( booking_id, tracking_number, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, cargo_type, arrival_deadline, booking_status ) ON target.booking_id = source.booking_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tracking_number = source.tracking_number, origin_unlocode = source.origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode = source.destination_unlocode, cargo_type = source.cargo_type, arrival_deadline = source.arrival_deadline, booking_status = source.booking_status, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( booking_id, tracking_number, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, cargo_type, arrival_deadline, booking_status, updated_at ) VALUES ( source.booking_id, source.tracking_number, source.origin_unlocode, source.destination_unlocode, source.cargo_type, source.arrival_deadline, source.booking_status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
